title: SG-5.1 · Export source interface and stable JSON export type
summary: Add an export source interface and a stable, documented JSON export type to the contribution package
description: Context: the devion workseed handoff needs frozen contributions in a stable format. backend/internal/contribution has Contribution, FileStore.ListByRound and no export types. Desired behavior: the package exposes an export source interface and a JSON export type carrying round id, contribution ids, authors, content and timestamps, with documentation, importing no removed code (worker, execution). Why: removal of dev automation must not break the handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contribution package, when compiled, then an exported export source interface and an exported JSON export type exist
Given an export value, when marshalled to JSON, then it contains round id, and per contribution id, author, content and created-at timestamp
Given export.go files, when imports are inspected, then none reference worker or execution packages

in_scope: New types and interface in backend/internal/contribution
preserve: Existing Contribution, FileStore and Repository behavior

definition_of_done: Types, interface and docs exist and compile
non_functional: JSON field names are stable snake_case
